policy.title: Configure quiet hours
policy.description: The selected provider's supported option names are shown below. Home Assistant Cloud voice variants use the voice option. If the start and end times are the same, quiet mode is active all day.

override.title: Configure the quiet override
override.description: Choose a listed voice when available, or enter the provider's exact voice/style value. Voice availability can vary by request language.
